rune_system.primary_path: 3 slots (slot_1, slot_2, slot_3) from one path
rune_system.secondary_path: 1 slot (any rune from a different path)
rune_system.adaptive_force_note: 1 pt Adaptive Force = 0.5 bonus AD or 1 AP

runes.name: Electrocute
runes.brief: Burst damage after 3 unique hits within 3s.
runes.full: Hitting a champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities within 3 seconds deals 40-194 (based on level) (+35% bonus AD)(+20% AP) bonus Adaptive damage.
runes.when_to_pick: Champion can reliably land 3 separate hits in quick succession
runes.why_to_pick: Best single-target burst keystone; ideal for all-in assassin trades

patch_history.change: Moved from Domination keystone to universal Keystone pool.

runes.name: Dark Harvest
runes.brief: Bonus damage on low-HP champions; stacks souls on takedown.
runes.full: Damaging a champion below 50% HP deals bonus Adaptive damage and harvests a soul. Souls permanently increase Dark Harvest damage. Champion takedowns within 3s reset the cooldown.
runes.when_to_pick: Games expected to go late; team has reliable poke/finish
runes.why_to_pick: Infinite scaling damage with soul stacking; punishes low-HP targets

runes.name: Empowerment
runes.brief: Gain adaptive force after being out of champion combat.
runes.full: After being out of champion combat for a duration, gain bonus Adaptive Force for the next ability or attack against an enemy champion.
runes.when_to_pick: Roaming playstyle with frequent flank engages
runes.why_to_pick: Extra burst from fog/roam; rewards patient ambush plays

runes.name: Lethal Tempo
runes.brief: Stacking attack speed on hit; at max stacks grants bonus range and exceeds AS cap.
runes.full: Attacking a champion generates a stack for 6 seconds, stacking up to 6 times. Each stack grants (Melee: 8%-16% / Ranged: 3%-10%) bonus attack speed (based on level). At max stacks: gain (Melee: 50 / Ranged: 75) bonus attack range and can exceed the attack speed cap. Stacks expire 1 per 0.5s.
runes.when_to_pick: Extended auto-attack trades; on-hit or AS-heavy champions
runes.why_to_pick: Best sustained DPS keystone; exceeding AS cap is unique and powerful

runes.name: Fleet Footwork
runes.brief: Energized attack heals and grants movement speed.
runes.full: Moving and attacking generates Energize stacks. At 100 stacks, your next attack is Energized, healing you and granting 20% bonus movement speed for 1 second.
runes.when_to_pick: Need lane sustain and kiting ability in trades
runes.why_to_pick: Reliable sustain + MS in lane; scales decently into teamfights

runes.name: Conqueror
runes.brief: Stacking adaptive force on hit; at max stacks grants omnivamp.
runes.full: Attacking or dealing ability damage to a champion generates a stack for 6 seconds, stacking up to 6 times. Each stack grants 3-7 bonus AD or 4-11 AP (Adaptive) (based on level). At max stacks: gain (Melee: 9% / Ranged: 5%) omnivamp. Stacks expire 1 per 0.5s.
runes.when_to_pick: Extended trades and teamfights; melee fighters especially
runes.why_to_pick: Best sustained combat keystone; free AD/AP + omnivamp at max stacks

runes.name: Grasp of the Undying
runes.brief: After stacking in combat, next attack deals bonus magic damage, heals, and grants permanent HP.
runes.full: Entering champion combat generates a stack every second, up to 3. At 3 stacks: your next attack deals (Melee: 2% / Ranged: 0.8%) max HP magic damage, heals you for (Melee: 2.5% / Ranged: 1%) max HP, and permanently grants (Melee: 10 / Ranged: 4) bonus HP.
runes.when_to_pick: Short trades in lane; tank/bruiser scaling builds
runes.why_to_pick: Permanent HP stacking + lane sustain; best tank keystone

runes.name: Guardian
runes.brief: Shield nearby ally when either takes damage.
runes.full: Guard allies within range. When you or a guarded ally takes damage, both of you gain a shield and bonus movement speed for a short duration.
runes.when_to_pick: Protecting fragile carry in duo lane; reactive shielding
runes.why_to_pick: Only keystone that passively protects allies; good for peel supports

runes.name: Aery
runes.brief: Aery damages enemies or shields allies on ability hit.
runes.full: Damaging an enemy champion sends Aery to them, dealing 15-70 (based on level) (+20% bonus AD)(+10% AP) Adaptive damage. Shielding or healing an ally sends Aery to them, granting a 30-140 (based on level) (+40% bonus AD)(+20% AP) shield for 2 seconds.
runes.cooldown: Aery travel time (returns after reaching target)
runes.when_to_pick: Frequent ability poke or frequent shielding/healing
runes.why_to_pick: Most versatile Sorcery keystone; works offense and defense

runes.name: Arcane Comet
runes.brief: Ability damage hurls a comet at target location.
runes.full: Damaging an enemy champion with an ability hurls a comet at their current location, dealing Adaptive damage in an area after a short delay. CD is reduced by ability hits on champions.
runes.cooldown: 12-8s (based on level), reduced by ability hits
runes.when_to_pick: Champion has slows/CC to guarantee comet landing
runes.why_to_pick: Higher poke damage than Aery for mages with CC to land it

runes.name: Phase Rush
runes.brief: 3 hits on a champion grants large movement speed burst and reduces basic ability CDs.
runes.full: Hitting a champion with 3 attacks or abilities within 4s grants bonus Movement Speed and reduces remaining basic ability cooldowns by 20%. Melee: 40%-60% MS. Ranged: 30%-50% MS. Duration: 3s. Ability Haste: 25.
runes.when_to_pick: Need to kite or stick to targets after combo
runes.why_to_pick: Best anti-kite/kiting keystone; CD reduction is a hidden strength

runes.name: First Strike
runes.brief: Dealing damage first in combat grants bonus gold and a damage amp window.
runes.full: If you deal damage to a champion before they damage you, gain gold and deal bonus true damage for the next 3 seconds. Gold generation scales with damage dealt.

values.gold_generation: 100% of bonus damage dealt as gold

runes.when_to_pick: Can reliably poke/initiate before enemy responds
runes.why_to_pick: Only keystone that generates gold; snowball advantage

runes.name: Ice Overlord
runes.brief: Abilities and attacks apply Frost stacks; at max stacks, freezes the target.
runes.full: Attacks and abilities apply Frost stacks to enemy champions. At max stacks, the target is frozen (rooted) for a short duration and takes bonus magic damage.
runes.when_to_pick: Champion applies many rapid hits (abilities or attacks)
runes.why_to_pick: Free CC on any champion; devastating with rapid multi-hit abilities

runes.name: Cheap Shot
runes.brief: Bonus true damage to CC'd targets.
runes.full: Damaging a champion with impaired movement or actions deals 12-45 (based on level) bonus true damage.
runes.when_to_pick: Kit has built-in CC
runes.why_to_pick: Free true damage on every CC; low CD

runes.name: Sudden Impact
runes.brief: Gain armor pen and magic pen after using a dash, blink, or stealth.
runes.full: After using a dash, blink, or exiting stealth, gain 7 armor penetration and 8 magic penetration for 5 seconds.
runes.when_to_pick: Kit has dash/blink/stealth
runes.why_to_pick: Best slot 1 Domination rune; free dual penetration

runes.name: Empowered Attack
runes.brief: Gain bonus on-hit damage periodically.
runes.full: Periodically empower your next basic attack to deal bonus Adaptive damage.
runes.when_to_pick: Rely on auto attacks for trades
runes.why_to_pick: Simple free damage for auto-attack playstyles

runes.name: Chain Assault
runes.brief: Bonus damage on repeated hits to same target.
runes.full: Hitting the same enemy champion with attacks or abilities grants stacking bonus damage.
runes.when_to_pick: Extended focus on single targets
runes.why_to_pick: Rewards committing to one target

runes.name: Tyrant
runes.brief: Bonus damage to low-HP champions.
runes.full: Deal bonus Adaptive damage to champions below 50% HP.
runes.when_to_pick: Need help finishing kills
runes.why_to_pick: Consistent execute-range damage amp

runes.name: Hubris
runes.brief: Gain adaptive force on champion takedowns.
runes.full: Champion takedowns grant stacking Adaptive Force for a duration.
runes.when_to_pick: Expect to get early kills
runes.why_to_pick: Snowball rune; rewards aggressive kills

runes.name: Eyeball Collection
runes.brief: Collect eyeballs on takedowns for permanent adaptive force.
runes.full: Champion takedowns grant eyeballs. Each eyeball grants bonus Adaptive Force. At max stacks, gain a bonus Adaptive Force reward.
runes.when_to_pick: Default scaling option in Domination Slot 3
runes.why_to_pick: Permanent damage scaling; simple and reliable

runes.name: Ingenious Hunter
runes.brief: Item active and passive cooldown reduction, stacking on unique takedowns.
runes.full: Gain item haste per unique champion takedown. Starts with base item haste.
runes.when_to_pick: Build relies on item actives/passives with cooldowns
runes.why_to_pick: Reduces key item CDs significantly at full stacks

runes.name: Relentless Hunter
runes.brief: Out-of-combat movement speed, stacking on unique takedowns.
runes.full: Gain bonus out-of-combat movement speed per unique champion takedown.
runes.when_to_pick: Roam-heavy playstyle
runes.why_to_pick: Speeds up rotations; weaker than alternatives in fights

runes.name: Zombie Ward
runes.brief: Destroying wards spawns friendly zombie wards; gain adaptive force.
runes.full: Destroying an enemy ward spawns a friendly Zombie Ward. Zombie Wards grant adaptive force stacks.
runes.when_to_pick: Vision-focused support/jungle
runes.why_to_pick: Free vision + free stats; strong in organized play

runes.name: Brutal
runes.brief: Flat adaptive force and penetration.
runes.full: Gain bonus Adaptive Force (AD or AP) and bonus penetration (armor or magic).
runes.when_to_pick: Default early-game damage option
runes.why_to_pick: Simple stat rune; strong early trades

runes.name: Triumph
runes.brief: Heal on champion takedowns.
runes.full: Champion takedowns restore a percentage of your missing HP and grant bonus gold.
runes.when_to_pick: Teamfight-heavy compositions
runes.why_to_pick: Clutch heal to survive chain fights; bonus gold

runes.name: Battle Zeal
runes.brief: Gain attack speed after dealing damage to a champion.
runes.full: Dealing damage to an enemy champion grants bonus attack speed for a short duration.
runes.when_to_pick: Auto-attack-reliant champion wanting combat AS
runes.why_to_pick: Reliable AS boost for trading and extended fights

runes.name: Last Stand
runes.brief: Increased damage when low HP.
runes.full: Deal increased damage when below 50% HP. Maximum bonus at 35% HP or below.
runes.when_to_pick: Champion fights at low HP regularly (drain tanks, bruisers)
runes.why_to_pick: Highest total damage amp of the slot 2 trio for sustained fighters

runes.name: Cut Down
runes.brief: Bonus damage to champions with more max HP than you.
runes.full: Deal bonus damage to champions with more maximum HP than you. Scales with HP difference.
runes.when_to_pick: Enemy team has tanks/high-HP champions
runes.why_to_pick: Best anti-tank damage amp rune; scales with enemy HP

runes.name: Coup de Grace
runes.brief: Bonus damage to low-HP champions.
runes.full: Deal bonus damage to champions below 35% HP.
runes.when_to_pick: Need to secure kills on low-HP targets
runes.why_to_pick: Consistent execute-range amp; pairs with burst combos

runes.name: Legend: Alacrity
runes.brief: Permanent attack speed stacking on takedowns.
runes.full: Gain permanent attack speed per Legend stack. Legend stacks are earned from champion takedowns and large monster kills.
runes.when_to_pick: Default for AS-reliant champions
runes.why_to_pick: Best permanent scaling AS rune

runes.name: Legend: Tenacity
runes.brief: Permanent tenacity stacking on takedowns.
runes.full: Gain permanent tenacity per Legend stack.
runes.when_to_pick: Enemy has heavy CC and you need tenacity stacking
runes.why_to_pick: Only rune that gives scaling tenacity; niche but powerful vs CC

runes.name: Legend: Bloodline
runes.brief: Permanent physical vamp stacking on takedowns.
runes.full: Gain permanent physical vamp per Legend stack.
runes.when_to_pick: Need sustain through auto attacks without buying early lifesteal
runes.why_to_pick: Free lifesteal scaling; delays need for sustain items

runes.name: Demolish
runes.brief: Charged attack deals bonus damage to turrets based on max HP.
runes.full: While near an enemy turret, charge up a powerful attack over 3 seconds. The charged attack deals bonus physical damage to the turret based on your max HP.
runes.when_to_pick: Plan to push turrets aggressively
runes.why_to_pick: Huge turret chunk damage; accelerates split pushing

runes.name: Font of Life
runes.brief: CC'ing a champion marks them; allies attacking marked targets heal.
runes.full: Impairing the movement of an enemy champion marks them. Allied champions who attack marked targets heal over 2 seconds.
runes.when_to_pick: Tank support with frequent CC application
runes.why_to_pick: Team-wide healing through CC; triggers Ardent Censer

runes.name: Courage of the Colossus
runes.brief: Gain a shield after hard CC'ing an enemy champion.
runes.full: Immobilizing an enemy champion grants you a shield based on your max HP plus bonus per nearby enemy champion.
runes.when_to_pick: Champion has hard CC and engages into multiple enemies
runes.why_to_pick: Shields scale with number of enemies; rewards engage plays

runes.name: Unshakeable
runes.brief: Gain tenacity and slow resistance.
runes.full: Gain bonus tenacity and slow resistance.
runes.when_to_pick: Facing heavy CC/slow compositions
runes.why_to_pick: Stacks with other tenacity sources; always-on anti-CC

runes.name: Second Wind
runes.brief: Regenerate HP after taking damage from a champion.
runes.full: After taking damage from an enemy champion, regenerate a percentage of your missing HP over a few seconds.
runes.when_to_pick: Against poke lanes or frequent trading
runes.why_to_pick: Best generic sustain rune; stronger the more you're poked

runes.name: Nullifying Orb
runes.brief: Magic damage shield when taken to low HP.
runes.full: When you take magic damage that would reduce you below 35% HP, gain a shield that absorbs magic damage.
runes.when_to_pick: Facing heavy AP burst (Syndra, Fizz, etc.)
runes.why_to_pick: Anti-magic survival shield; niche but life-saving vs AP burst

runes.name: Bone Plating
runes.brief: After being hit, next 3 instances of damage are reduced.
runes.full: After taking damage from an enemy champion, the next 3 instances of damage from champions are reduced.
runes.when_to_pick: Facing burst trades or all-in combos
runes.why_to_pick: Strongest short-trade defense; negates burst combos

runes.name: Overgrowth
runes.brief: Gain permanent max HP from nearby minion deaths.
runes.full: Absorb life force from nearby minion deaths, permanently gaining bonus max HP. After absorbing enough, gain additional bonus HP.
runes.when_to_pick: Default Resolve slot 3 for HP scaling
runes.why_to_pick: Free permanent HP; strongest generic Resolve slot 3

runes.name: Revitalize
runes.brief: Bonus healing and shielding power; stronger on low-HP targets.
runes.full: Outgoing and incoming heals and shields are increased. This bonus is increased on targets below 50% HP.
runes.when_to_pick: Champion has heals or shields in kit
runes.why_to_pick: Amplifies all healing/shielding; strongest on enchanter supports

runes.name: Perseverance
runes.brief: Bonus tenacity and slow resistance scaling with missing HP.
runes.full: Gain bonus tenacity and slow resistance that increases based on your missing HP.
runes.when_to_pick: Facing heavy CC; expect to be low HP in teamfights
runes.why_to_pick: Scaling tenacity is massive in teamfights when low

runes.name: Axiom Arcanist
runes.brief: Gain adaptive force; bonus increases at certain levels.
runes.full: Gain bonus Adaptive Force that increases at level thresholds.
runes.when_to_pick: Default stat rune for Sorcery slot 1
runes.why_to_pick: Simple adaptive force scaling; reliable

runes.name: Manaflow Band
runes.brief: Hitting champions with abilities grants permanent max mana; at max stacks gain mana regen.
runes.full: Hitting an enemy champion with an ability permanently increases your max mana. At max stacks, gain bonus mana regeneration.
runes.when_to_pick: Champion runs out of mana frequently
runes.why_to_pick: Solves mana issues; bonus regen at full stacks

runes.name: Botanist
runes.brief: Enhance fruit and plant interactions.
runes.full: Honeyfruit and other plants grant enhanced effects. Gain bonus movement speed after interacting with plants.
runes.when_to_pick: Jungler or champion that frequently uses river plants
runes.why_to_pick: Free sustain and MS from plants; especially strong for junglers

runes.name: Hexflash
runes.brief: While Flash is on CD, gain Hexflash: a channeled short-range blink.
runes.full: While Flash has a remaining cooldown greater than 2 seconds, it is replaced by Hexflash. Channel for up to 6.5s to blink 150-400 range. Entering combat cancels and incurs 10s CD.
runes.when_to_pick: Need Flash-like engages more frequently than Flash CD allows
runes.why_to_pick: Extra blink while Flash is down; game-changing engages from fog

patch_history.change: Moved from Inspiration Slot 1 to Sorcery Slot 1.

runes.name: Transcendence
runes.brief: Bonus ability haste; champion takedowns reduce basic ability CDs.
runes.full: Gain bonus ability haste. Champion takedowns reduce remaining basic ability cooldowns by a percentage.
runes.when_to_pick: Value ability haste and frequent ability usage
runes.why_to_pick: Free AH + CD refund on kills; core on most mages

runes.name: Celerity
runes.brief: Bonus movement speed.
runes.full: Gain bonus movement speed. Bonus movement speed from all sources is increased by a percentage.
runes.when_to_pick: MS-stacking build or champion that scales with MS
runes.why_to_pick: Amplifies all MS sources; niche but synergistic

runes.name: Absolute Focus
runes.brief: Bonus adaptive force when above 70% HP.
runes.full: Gain bonus Adaptive Force when above 70% HP.
runes.when_to_pick: Can maintain high HP in lane (safe playstyle)
runes.why_to_pick: Free AF while healthy; good for poke/siege

runes.name: Scorch
runes.brief: Ability damage burns enemies for bonus magic damage.
runes.full: Your next ability hit sets an enemy champion on fire, dealing bonus magic damage over time.
runes.when_to_pick: Want early lane poke pressure
runes.why_to_pick: Best early-game Sorcery slot 3 rune; falls off late

runes.name: Nimbus Cloak
runes.brief: Gain movement speed after casting a summoner spell.
runes.full: After casting a summoner spell, gain a burst of movement speed decaying over a short duration.
runes.when_to_pick: Want MS burst on Flash/Ignite/Exhaust usage
runes.why_to_pick: Universal utility; MS on every summoner spell use

runes.name: Gathering Storm
runes.brief: Gain adaptive force that increases over game time.
runes.full: Every few minutes, gain increasing amounts of Adaptive Force.
runes.when_to_pick: Expect long games; champion scales well
runes.why_to_pick: Infinite scaling damage; best late-game Sorcery slot 3

runes.name: Ixtali Seedjar
runes.brief: Gain seeds near plants; seeds grant small heals or buffs.
runes.full: Periodically gain a seed. Walking near a plant or brush consumes a seed to grant a small heal or combat buff.
runes.when_to_pick: Jungler wanting additional sustain from seeds
runes.why_to_pick: Very niche; generally weaker than alternatives
